name: specsket
description: Analyze project briefs, research specifiable products, and stage evidence-backed project, product, supplier, vendor-onboarding, or vendor-storefront proposals for review.

interface.shortDescription: Project intelligence and product sourcing workflows
interface.longDescription: Tag Specsket Workflows Beta to analyze project briefs and requirements, profile and normalize products, resolve vendors, run product discovery or supplier onboarding, and prepare governed vendor onboarding or storefront proposals. Enable the separate Specsket MCP Tools Beta connection for live project context, schemas, validation, staged review records, and signed-in review links. The plugin cannot create or activate vendors, apply or publish storefronts, or publish or approve records.
defaultPrompt: Find a fast shortlist of products for my project
Analyze these project briefs into rooms and layered requirements
Normalize and stage these product or supplier records
